title: spisor marketplace list
description: A marketplace as its owner writes it: a list of repository ids with an optional alias, description and categories. It holds no name of a repository, so renaming one changes nothing here.

$schema.description: Pointer at the published schema, for an editor's completion and validation.

format.description: The version of this document's shape.

title.description: What this marketplace is called, for a surface to show.

entries.description: The entries, in the order a surface lists them. A repeated id is accepted here and refused when a copy is built.

id.description: The repository identity of the listed repository, which survives a rename.
id.fix: write the id as a repository id, for example "git:dd92836cca7c292258635112ecfe1acb7b4f6ecd" or that id followed by "/runtime"

at.description: Where to start looking for the repository: the places the list's owner recorded for it, provider numbers, web domains or git urls, which survive a rename.

items.fix: write the place as <provider>:<number>, <provider>@<host>:<number>, web:<domain> or an https url

at.fix: list at least one place, for example ["gitea@git.example.com:12"]

alias.description: The name this marketplace calls the entry by, set only to settle a clash with another entry of the same name.
alias.fix: use lowercase words joined by single hyphens or dots, for example "config-ledger" or "api.http"

description.description: A short line saying what the entry is.

categories.description: Topics this entry is filed under, each written as an import name.

items.fix: use lowercase words joined by single hyphens or dots, for example "config-ledger" or "api.http"

categories.fix: list categories as lowercase hyphenated words, for example ["ai-provider"]
